topic: Retention in a fictional queue service
scope: The supplied synthetic reference only; no real product claims

facts.statement: The fictional service defaults to 24-hour retention and permits 1 to 72 hours.
facts.author: example-author

citations.quote:
The queue retains messages for 24 hours by default. Operators can configure
retention from 1 to 72 hours.

findings.title: Choose retention within the documented range

summary.text: Retention is configurable rather than fixed at the default.

implications.text: For this fictional service, choose retention to match the required recovery window within the documented range.

gaps.text: Throughput and the effect of retention on resource use remain unmeasured.

blocks.text: The fictional queue defaults to 24 hours of retention, with a configurable range of 1 to 72 hours.
Select a recovery window within the supported range, retaining the 72-hour upper limit when summarizing this example.
